Howl Of A Dog is a nonprofit animal rescue organization - www.HowlOfADog.org.
Our commitment is to rescue abandoned, homeless, neglected and abused dogs (and other animals) from the streets or from local kill-shelters and to find them suitable loving forever homes. At the same time, our efforts aim to build a more compassionate and responsible society, develop education programs for the young generations and support neutering/spaying campaigns in order to reduce dog overpopulation in Romania.

To help us rescue more homeless animals and find them forever homes please visit: http://www.HowlOfADog.org

PayPal: donate@howlofadog.org
Email: contact@howlofadog.org
Website: www.howlofadog.org
Facebook: www.facebook.com/HowlOfADog
Twitter:  twitter.com/HowlOfADog
Instagram: www.instagram.com/howlofadog

Thank you!
